archive.source: Each role from the page cited with it, read 2026-09-26. The SGA re-editions (Gille–Polo, Laszlo–Orgogozo) re-edit published seminars, not the fonds, and are left out; so are original members of the Grothendieck Circle with no other documented role.

roles.what: Received the fonds from Grothendieck (late June/early July 1990 and 28 July 1995), kept it at home until 2010, deposited it at the University of Montpellier; donated it to Université Montpellier 2 in 2012 (CA deliberation 6 July 2012)
Assisted the contract archivists during the 2015–16 classification: context, deciphering, identifying research themes; with them proposed the bracketed folder titles
La Longue Marche à travers la théorie de Galois, Tome 1 (§1–37), transcription of an unpublished manuscript, Université Montpellier II, 253 p. (cited in the inventory note to the 140-1–4 group)
Les Dérivateurs, co-editor with M. Künzer and G. Maltsiniotis; supplied the copy of the manuscript and compared the original against the TeX version
Motifs: transcription 'assurée par Ph. Elbaz-Vincent avec l'aide de J. Malgoire' (title page)
Contract archivist recruited Nov. 2015 for six months to classify the fonds and prepare it for conservation digitisation; co-author of the 'Présentation générale du fonds Grothendieck'
Contract archivist recruited Nov. 2015 for six months to classify the fonds and prepare it for conservation digitisation; co-author of the 'Présentation générale du fonds Grothendieck'
Head of the Service des archives of the University of Montpellier; directed the 2015–16 classification mission and the inventory introduction ('sous la direction de')
Pursuing Stacks (À la poursuite des champs), vol. I, SMF Documents Mathématiques 20 (sections 1–91, 95–98); vol. II announced
Online edition of section 69 of Pursuing Stacks, and PS-related correspondence (to Verdier, with R. Brown, from Joyal, to Thomason) 'en cours d'édition'
Les Dérivateurs, co-editor with M. Künzer and J. Malgoire (online, IMJ-PRG)
Correspondence A. Grothendieck – R. Brown: collaborator on M. Künzer's edition
Les Dérivateurs: deciphering and LaTeX transcription of the 1976-page manuscript, and help with the edition
Grothendieck's letters to Ronnie Brown 1982–1991 (with the collaboration of R. Brown and G. Maltsiniotis)
Lettre à R. Thomason, 2.4.1991 (credited editor on CSG)
Original member of the Grothendieck Circle
Original member of the Grothendieck Circle; the site 'is updated by Leila Schneps' (collection of scanned/typed unpublished texts, letters)

Geometric Galois Actions I: Around Grothendieck's Esquisse d'un Programme (LMS LNS 242), co-edited with P. Lochak; contains Esquisse d'un Programme with English translation and the 1983 letter to Faltings
Bilingual Grothendieck–Serre correspondence (AMS/SMF), translation with Catriona Maclean
Geometric Galois Actions I (LMS LNS 242), co-edited with L. Schneps; contains Esquisse d'un Programme
Original member of the Grothendieck Circle (listed as Pierre Alexandre Lochak)

Motifs (manuscript c. 1965–1970, 'très préliminaire et de déchiffrement difficile'): transcription by Ph. Elbaz-Vincent with the help of J. Malgoire; title page marked 'NE PAS DIFFUSER'; now served openly by CSG
Translated EGA 5 (prenotes) in 1987 — inventory footnote to cote 24, correspondence in 181/18; cote 25 notes 'voir cote 24'
English translation of the EGA V prenotes with Joseph Blass; Grothendieck gave him the prenotes in 1987 (171-page scan on the Circle)
EGA V, 'Edition by J. Blass, P. Blass, S. Klasa', Ulam Quarterly 1992–1996; CSG: 'Original: Archives Montpellier, Cote No. 24'
English translation of the EGA V prenotes with Piotr Blass
EGA V edition with P. Blass and S. Klasa, Ulam Quarterly
'Improved, revised and completed version' of EGA V 5 with P. Blass, published in the Ulam Quarterly Journal
EGA V edition by J. Blass, P. Blass, S. Klasa, Ulam Quarterly
Former Coordinator and current Archivist of the Centre for Grothendieckian Studies (CSG, Istituto Grothendieck)
Pursuing Stacks arXiv edition (ix+514 pp.): 'extended and revised version by Mateo Carmona with the collaboration of Ulrik Buchholtz' of the 2015 public-domain edition by 'thescrivener'

La 'longue marche' à travers la théorie de Galois (§1–37, 306 pp. draft), CSG project under his supervision, 'derived from an unpublished scan provided by the Montpellier archive … Cote n°s 140-2 - 140-4'
Esquisse d'un programme (50 pp. draft), from 'Cote n° 119', CSG project under his supervision

Unpublished works credited 'Mateo Carmona et al.' with Montpellier cotes on CSG: Esquisse thématique (1972), En guise de programme (1978), Rapport d'activité (1984) and Rapport d'activité 1.10–15.12.1984 [119]; Travaux de thèses (1964) [66]; Polyèdres réguliers (1976) [69]; Géométrie de l'icosaèdre and Géométrie arithmétique des polygônes réguliers (1977/78) [75]

Letters credited 'Mateo Carmona et al.' with Montpellier cotes on CSG: to Murre 1959 [29]; Hironaka 1962, Murre 1962 (two) [57]; Serre 12.8.1964 [44]; Deligne 10.12.1965 [5]; Coates 1966, 1967 [16]; Anantharaman 1967 [91]; Verdier, Deligne, Michon, Ferrand 3.11.1970 and Verdier 23.6.1971 [37]; Deligne 7.8.1974 and Deligne/Giraud/Verdier 23.6.1974 [103]; Bers 1984 [67]
Collaborator on M. Carmona's revised arXiv edition of Pursuing Stacks
Coordinator of the Centre for Grothendieckian Studies (CSG), whose catalogue ties works and letters to Montpellier cotes and which coordinates editions of unpublished manuscripts
Correspondance Grothendieck–Serre, SMF Documents Mathématiques 2 (with P. Colmez); a selection, not the complete correspondence
Correspondance Grothendieck–Serre, SMF Documents Mathématiques 2 (with J.-P. Serre)
Bilingual edition of the Grothendieck–Serre correspondence (AMS/SMF), with L. Schneps
Résidus et dualité, Prénotes pour un 'Séminaire Hartshorne' (Grothendieck's 1963 typed prenotes, previously unpublished), SMF Documents Mathématiques 21, with preface
English translation of the 1991 letter to R. Thomason on derivators
English version (Thematic Sketch) of the Esquisse thématique, 'courtesy of G. Aiello'
Collaborator on M. Künzer's edition of the Grothendieck–Brown correspondence

Co-author (with S. Maronne, collab. D. Calaque) of the exhibition and booklet 'Grothendieck mathématicien. Le temps des réflexions 1973-1991', IMT Toulouse, 9 Dec 2024–31 Jan 2025; the Montpellier archive pages 'ont fourni l'essentiel de la documentation et de l'iconographie'
Co-author of the exhibition/booklet 'Grothendieck mathématicien. Le temps des réflexions 1973-1991', built chiefly from the Montpellier archives
Collaborator on the Toën–Maronne exhibition/booklet drawn from the Montpellier archives
